body.text: Coordination half of U13. auto-nudge presses its guard Enter only while holding the engine per-recipient lock (non-blocking), starts a detached --redeliver when an input with deferred messages is clear and stacks no nudge behind it, names pending ids in the composer alert, and reports each terminal redelivery once by id, sender and recipient. ci-notify, codex-duo-handoff and the alerts allow 120 s (> 90 s send budget); ci-notify records exit 4 as deferred. Engine gitlink -> 7d9e5c7 (the engine tests tip). Tests: linked PR from test/msg-u13-coordination.
